Invoice No.ambiguity_notes: Never the shipper commercial (party) invoice no, IRN, or job/customer numbers.

Invoice Date.ambiguity_notes: Not due date, ack date, or sailing/flight dates.

Container Number.ambiguity_notes: Entity field, not a charge. Validate ISO 6346 check digit where possible.

MAWB No.semantic_description: Master air waybill identifier (air shipments only)
MAWB No.ambiguity_notes: Entity field. AWB Charges / fees are charge fields, not this.

HAWB No.semantic_description: House air waybill identifier (air shipments only)
HAWB No.ambiguity_notes: Entity field. A label like 'H B/L No./HAWB No.' holds the house document; decide B/L vs AWB from transport mode.

Vendor Name.ambiguity_notes: The issuer, never the bill-to customer, shipper, consignee, or bank.

Bill of Lading / HBL.semantic_description: House (or master) bill of lading reference (sea shipments)
Bill of Lading / HBL.ambiguity_notes: Entity field, not BL Charges. If only one BL number exists and it is not clearly master, treat as house.

WEIGHT.semantic_description: Shipment weight as printed, with unit
WEIGHT.ambiguity_notes: Keep the printed unit. VGM is a weighing fee, not the weight itself.

Ex Rate.semantic_description: Foreign-currency to INR rates printed on the invoice
Ex Rate.ambiguity_notes: Currency conversion rates only (skip INR->INR). Line-item unit rates are not Ex Rate.
